import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 我的回忆指令处理器
 * 指令：/我的回忆
 * 展示玩家个人历程中几个关键"第一次"节点，以故事化短文呈现
 */
import App from '@src/response-apps/memory/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const result = await App({ uid, bid });

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (result.code !== 'OK') {
    md.addText('回忆加载失败，请稍后再试');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '我的回忆', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const { items, totalDays, name } = result.data;

  md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${name}，你已在这片天地走过了 ${totalDays} 天。`));

  items.forEach(item => {
    md.addText(`【${item.label}】`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(item.text);
    if (item.subtext) {
      md.addNewline();
      md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(item.subtext));
    }
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
  });

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '我的回忆',
      content: md,
      footer: result.data.canShowStoryButton ? [{ label: '我的故事', command: '/我的故事' }] : undefined
    })
  );
});
